# Contractor OS

> The operating system for contracting businesses — leads, estimates, jobs, GPS-verified time tracking, boss-approved hours, job costing, and an AI admin & phone answering assistant.

Contractor OS helps small and mid-size contractors run their business end-to-end from one app. Crews clock in on-site with GPS, owners approve hours, and the AI assistant drafts estimates, schedules jobs, and answers phone calls.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and core features.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Monthly plans — Base ($69), Plus ($169, adds AI assistant), Premium ($269, adds AI phone answering).
- [CRM for contractors](/features/contractor-crm): Centralized lead, customer, and communication tracking built for contractors.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the Contractor OS team.
